facts.text: Under NC Promise, undergraduate tuition at Western Carolina University is $500 per semester for in-state students and $3,500 for out-of-state students.

sources.title: NC Promise: Use Your Advantage - Western Carolina University
sources.quote: Through NC Promise, tuition for all undergraduate students at WCU has been reduced to $500 per fall and spring semesters for in-state students and $3,500 for out-of-state students.
